name: absvai
description: Abs Vai (absvai.com) seasonal multi-category marketplace on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev -c worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local -c worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:seed:demo:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --local -c worker/wrangler.toml --file worker/seed/demo.sql
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c worker/wrangler.toml
